findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_mcp_server" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: agentscan: Check whether a remote MCP server is up and what it offers. Returns a live check of a public remote MCP server: answers or not, name, version, protoc…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_endpoint_history, check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, x402_seller_report, get_x402_bazaar_pulse, check_mcp_server · Private data: query_agent_index, get_endpoint_history, export_agent_index, bulk_agent_index, check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, x402_seller_report, x402_listing_audit, check_mcp_server, scan_agent_package · Public sink: test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package · Destructive: export_agent_index, test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_endpoint_history, check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, x402_seller_report, get_x402_bazaar_pulse, check_mcp_server · Private data: query_agent_index, get_endpoint_history, export_agent_index, bulk_agent_index, check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, x402_seller_report, x402_listing_audit, check_mcp_server, scan_agent_package · Public sink: test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package · Destructive: export_agent_index, test_x402_payment, scan_agent_package

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
